chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah sees only good?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to elucidate the concept of *al-Nazar al-Jamil* (the Beautiful Gaze), illustrating how divine perfection necessitates viewing creation through the lens of goodness rather than defect. This principle serves as a cornerstone for Shia theological optimism, affirming that God’s attribute of *Jamal* (Beauty) overrides *Jalal* (Majesty) in His continuous observation of the universe. It provides believers with a metaphysical basis for trusting in divine wisdom, even amidst apparent worldly trials.
